status: Declared before computing any market-outcome menus using this evidence screen; the original empirical screen remains the primary developmental reference.
scope: Secondary conservative simultaneous-bound diagnostic, proposed after V1 and exploratory development exposure. It is not a new blind-final evaluation or real-market certificate.
assumptions: Whole 30-year paths are iid from one common synthetic distribution; the statement gives independence but does not explicitly establish identical distribution.

The policy/event family is fixed: 232 long-only 5pp/exact-thirds static annual targets, contest cost .0025, the five supplied H,L pairs. No forecast or adaptive-target fitting occurs inside a candidate.
bound: U_wj = Beta inverse survival(delta/1160;k_wj+1,n-k_wj) for k<n; U=1 at k=n. P(all fixed risks p_wj<=U_wj)>=1-delta by union bound.
selection: For each requested alpha, require U_wj<=alpha, then use the same predeclared common-menu coverage/minimax-regret/mean-regret rule. Because n and confidence allocation are shared, this is equivalent to a fixed maximum exceedance count computed mathematically before market fitting.
multiplicity: No extra factor for menus or alpha/floor cases when these reuse the same fixed p_wj bounds. Additional cost rates, fine-grid weights, horizons/L events, forecasts or dynamic rules are outside the 1160-event guarantee.
insufficient_evidence: If even k=0 has U>alpha, report that the sample cannot support that budget under this evidence standard; do not conclude that safe portfolios do not exist.
growth_severity: The joint bound covers individual product-client exceedance probabilities, not growth, regret, CVaR, all-client simultaneous non-loss, or model/DGP validity.
folds: Apply the same specified selection procedure to each 96-path training fold, evaluate frozen assignments on 24 test paths. OOF remains a mixed-policy dependent internal diagnostic; no joint confidence claim across folds. A joint assertion across all five training subsets would require additional multiplicity accounting.
bootstrap: Not used as extra independent evidence. If later used for configuration stability, duplicate paths do not create a new certificate.
reuse_history: The finite-family theorem permits data-dependent choices inside the fixed family. The family and iid assumptions must be stated, and its retrospective proposal disclosed. It cannot be extended to the former learned forecast/dynamic family merely by counting targets.
